stem.text: A musical instrument called a bugle is a long tube with a mouthpiece at one end. The other end is open and flared, as shown.

stem.alt: Outline of a long tube with a small mouthpiece bracket at the left end, widening into a flared bell at the right end.

stem.text: A musician maintains stationary sound waves with a node at the mouthpiece and an antinode at the other end. The lowest frequency of sound that the bugle can produce is $92\,\text{Hz}$.
Which different frequencies of sound can be produced by the bugle?
